title: Cantilever under a tip load, Timoshenko deflection (hex20)
source: Timoshenko and Gere, Mechanics of Materials (beam with shear deformation: δ = PL³/3EI + PL/κGA, κ = 5/6 for a rectangle); Cowper, J. Appl. Mech. 33 (1966) 335–340 for the shear coefficient
